content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Release Date: 22 August 2026 Last Date for Submission of Application: 15 September 2026 The official notification does not mention separate dates for shortlisting, written test, or interview. These will reportedly be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email, and any updates will be posted on the official website.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Vacancy 2026 Out: Department-wise Posts
content_sections.text: The university has advertised vacancies in six broad academic areas. Candidates can apply for the post of Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor depending on the department and their eligibility. In total, the notification covers 4 Professor posts, 6 Associate Professor posts, and 9 Assistant Professor posts across the six departments.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs by the level of the post. Candidates should carefully match their qualifications and experience against the criteria below before applying. Outstanding academic record with 60% marks or an equivalent grade at the Master's level, preferably with international teaching experience. Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline. 3 to 7 years of experience as an Associate Professor or equivalent, with substantive experience guiding doctoral and post-doctoral research. Preferably 10 publications as books and/or research/policy papers in peer-reviewed national or international journals. Evidence of innovative courses, teaching plans, or research is desirable. Brilliant academic record with 60% marks or an equivalent grade at the Master's level, preferably with international teaching experience. Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the allied/relevant discipline. 3 to 5 years of teaching and research experience at the national/international level, with experience guiding doctoral research. Preferably 8 publications as books and/or research/policy papers in peer-reviewed journals. Evidence of innovative courses, teaching plans, or research is desirable. Good academic record with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent grade at the Master's level in a relevant subject from an Indian or foreign university. Ph.D. or post-doctoral research in the allied/relevant discipline. Minimum 3 to 5 publications as books and/or research/policy papers in peer-reviewed journals. Evidence of innovative courses, teaching plans, or research is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: A doctorate (Ph.D.) with a consistently good academic record is the minimum educational qualification for all three posts. A minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade at the Master's level is also required. Degrees must be from a recognised university or institution of repute; for M.Phil./Ph.D. degrees from foreign universities, the university will determine equivalence as per applicable regulations.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay an application fee of Rs. 500 per post directly to the university's bank account. A separate application form and fee payment are required for each post applied for. The UTR/Transaction Reference Number must be mentioned in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that fulfilling the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an interview call. Where a large number of applications are received, the university may restrict the number of candidates called forward based on academic record, qualifications, experience, publications, and overall suitability. The university reserves the right to conduct any combination of the following, in online or offline mode: Written test Seminar/presentation Interview Any other assessment process deemed appropriate

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Completed CV / Expression of Interest with research profile and publication details Google Form Response Receipt Recent passport-sized photograph and signature Certificates and mark sheets of all examinations, including research degrees Proof of teaching, research, and professional experience Copies of published research papers and other academic contributions

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Log in to your Gmail account, since the application link is based on a Google Form. Create one first if you don't have one. Click on the official online application link and fill in all required details accurately. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500 per post directly to the university's bank account and note down the UTR/Transaction Reference Number. Submit a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. Download or note the Form Response Receipt after submission. Email the Form Response Receipt along with your CV and scanned copies of all relevant documents to [email protected] . Hard copies are not accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Can foreign nationals apply for Nalanda University teaching posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian nationals, Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs), Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs), and foreign nationals are all eligible to apply.

faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 per post, to be paid directly to the university's HDFC Bank account, with a separate payment required for each post applied for.
